rationale: FX03 flags cost_currency because the extracted unit token is U_USD rather than literal USD, but the raw schedule labels the valuation columns as Amortized Cost and Fair Value and prints dollar signs on the cost and fair value cells. The source therefore supports USD-denominated valuation fields; the warning reflects overly narrow unit-token handling rather than a data error in the holding values.
